# Security policy

<!-- Generated by scrum-github. Edit it freely: init never overwrites it. -->

## Supported versions

Security fixes go into the latest released version (the newest `{{TAG_PREFIX}}*` tag on `{{RELEASE_BRANCH}}`).
Older versions are not patched; upgrade to the latest one.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not open a public issue or pull request for a vulnerability.

Report it privately: on the repository page open **Security → Report a vulnerability** (GitHub
private vulnerability reporting). Describe the problem, how to reproduce it and the impact you
expect. You get an answer within five working days; the fix is published as a hotfix release, and
you are credited in the advisory unless you ask not to be.
